faq.label: FAQ
faq.heading: Common Questions
faq.sub: Everything you need to know about InterLink's services and internship program.
faq.a1: InterLink is a modern technology enterprise specialized in building intelligent digital systems (software, websites, and mobile apps), AI integrations, cybersecurity audits, IoT systems, and providing high-quality hands-on internship programs for tech students.
faq.q2: Who can apply for an internship at InterLink?
faq.a2: Active university students, coding school graduates, and self-taught developers specialized in Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, AI Development, Web/Mobile Apps, or Graphic Design are highly encouraged to apply.
faq.q3: How does the AI-powered platform work?
faq.a3: Our custom AI engines help student interns by suggesting relevant tasks, assisting in writing professional daily/weekly reports, and offering an inline AI chat assistant. For supervisors, the AI assists by reviewing reports and analyzing student progress.
faq.q4: Are the internship programs remote or on-site?
faq.a4: We offer hybrid, fully on-site, and fully remote internship opportunities, depending on your department and supervisor alignment.
faq.q5: Do I get a certificate at the end of the internship?
faq.a5: Yes! Upon successful completion of your internship and final supervisor review, InterLink issues a verified digital certificate complete with a secure verification QR code and a shareable digital portfolio.
faq.q6: Can InterLink build custom applications for my business?
faq.a6: Absolutely! Our professional team delivers high-performance software engineering, custom AI integrations, cybersecurity assessments, and branding/creative flyer and graphic design services for global clients.
faq.q7: How many hours of check-in are required per day?
faq.a7: We offer flexible tracks including Full-time (8h/day), Part-time (4h/day), and specialized self-paced evening project tracks.
faq.q8: When can I apply to start my internship?
faq.a8: New cohorts start every month for all active departments. Apply online and pass our automated skills assessment.
faq.a9: Our secure web dashboard serves as your primary workspace, enabling you to check in daily, draft reports, interact with your supervisor, use the AI Copilot, and review performance analytics.
